newsitem.title: TURKEY: Iranian President Rafsanjani leaves Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Iranian President Rafsanjani leaves Turkey.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani left Turkey on Sunday at the end of a four-day visit in which the two neighbouring countries pledged closer economic ties in defiance of U.S. efforts to isolate Iran.

Rafsanjani had been due to visit the eastern Black Sea port of Trabzon on the final leg of his visit, but his plane was unable to land due to poor weather conditons and instead continued directly onto Tehran, Anatolian news agency said.
During the visit, the two countries signed several accords to boost economic relations for which Turkey, a NATO member, was criticised by the United States.
The U.S. opposes links with Iran which it accuses of sponsoring terrorism. Iran denies the charge.
Rafsanjani's visit marked a strengthening of relations between the two Moslem countries since Necmettin Erbakan became Turkey's first Islamist prime minister in June.
